note: Public Microsoft AdventureWorks DW sample (MIT), loaded by samples/load_adventureworks.py. reference_sql writes the dates and values out, so it is computed independently of the resolver and of any model; expected is its result rounded to 4 dp. Regenerate with python -m eval.datasets.golden.make_chat_golden.

questions.question: What were internet sales of Mountain-200 Black, 38 in the Northwest in the last 10 days?
questions.note: the last 10 days of the data had no sales of this bike there: the answer must say so
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON f.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE p.EnglishProductName = 'Mountain-200 Black, 38' AND t.SalesTerritoryRegion = 'Northwest' AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2014-01-19' AND '2014-01-28'

questions.question: What were internet sales of Mountain-200 Black, 38 in the Northwest in 2013?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON f.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE p.EnglishProductName = 'Mountain-200 Black, 38' AND t.SalesTerritoryRegion = 'Northwest' AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'

questions.question: What were internet sales of Mountain-200 Black in 2013?
questions.note: model + colour: three sizes, no single product row is named
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey WHERE p.ModelName = 'Mountain-200' AND p.Color = 'Black' AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'

questions.question: Which product category had the highest reseller sales in 2013?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.EnglishProductCategoryName, ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey WHERE f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Internet sales by sales territory group in Q3 2013
questions.reference_sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryGroup, ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON f.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2013-09-30' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many online orders included helmets in France and Germany in 2013?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.SalesOrderNumber) AS orders FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON f.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE s.EnglishProductSubcategoryName = 'Helmets' AND t.SalesTerritoryRegion IN ('France', 'Germany') AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'

questions.question: What was the internet gross margin of Road Bikes in 2012?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalProductCost), 2) AS gross_margin FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey WHERE s.EnglishProductSubcategoryName = 'Road Bikes' AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'

questions.question: Top 5 products by internet sales in 2013
questions.note: a product name can have several ProductKey rows (price history): group by name
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.EnglishProductName, ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey WHERE f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Reseller sales by business type in 2012
questions.reference_sql: SELECT r.BusinessType, ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimReseller r ON f.ResellerKey = r.ResellerKey WHERE f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Internet sales by month in 2013
questions.reference_sql: SELECT substr(f.OrderDate, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f WHERE f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Reseller units of Mountain-200 last quarter
questions.note: reseller data ends 2013-11-29, so its 'last quarter' differs from internet's
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.OrderQuantity) AS units FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey WHERE p.ModelName = 'Mountain-200' AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-11-29'

questions.question: Internet sales in California in 2013
questions.note: the customer's state: FactInternetSales → DimCustomer → DimGeography
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount), 2) AS sales FROM FactInternetSales f JOIN DimCustomer cu ON f.CustomerKey = cu.CustomerKey JOIN DimGeography g ON cu.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey WHERE g.StateProvinceName = 'California' AND f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'

questions.question: Which sales territory region had the highest reseller gross margin in 2013?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT t.SalesTerritoryRegion, ROUND(SUM(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalProductCost), 2) AS gross_margin FROM FactResellerSales f JOIN DimSalesTerritory t ON f.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey WHERE f.OrderDate BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
